description.en: Opens a voice-line sound resource by name, returning a handle to play with CMND_SND_PLAY. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation and its similarity to the other CMND_SND_OPEN_* commands.
Name of the voice line to open.
Handle of the opened voice sound.

example.code:
// Open a character's voice line
local hVoice = CMND_SND_OPEN_VOICE("vc_tenma_001");
